name: home
headline: Your iPhone, in OBS.
sub: Open the app, tap Start Camera. OBS finds the phone over Wi-Fi or USB.

name: live-glance
headline: Up to 4K60, HEVC, 10-bit HDR.
sub: The picture is the interface. Tap to focus, hold to lock, pinch to zoom.

name: live-tray
headline: One tray for the whole camera.
sub: Exposure, shutter, white balance and focus, each with an auto you can trust.

name: format
headline: Balanced, or Maximum.
sub: Maximum finds the most your connection can carry and keeps it there.

name: options
headline: Remote start. Tally light. Remembered settings.
sub: Built for production, not for fiddling with mid-stream.

name: obs
headline: Live in OBS in a second or two.
sub: Automatic lip-sync aligns your real microphone. Nothing leaves your network.
